title: DSE plant
description: Generated from the catalogue of modules: Dse.Components, Dse.Control. Do not edit; run `dse schema export`.

defaults.description: Simulation options used when nothing overrides them. A scenario or the command line may.

seed.description: Master seed; every random stream derives from it.

startTime.description: Simulation start, ISO 8601 with an offset.

controllers.description: Control blocks, scanned in the order listed: when two write one tag on one tick, the later wins.

block.alarm.description: An ISA-18.2 analog alarm over one Double tag: one to four limits, each with a deadband and an on-delay, acknowledged by Ack.

id.description: Unique across the plant's components and controllers. No dot and no whitespace: it prefixes every tag the block owns, as in INT01.Ok.

scanPeriodMs.description: How often the block scans, in milliseconds: a whole number of time steps, at most a day.

claims.description: Tags only this block may write, by full name: each a read-write tag the block commands. A client, a scenario or another block that writes one is refused.

input.description: The Double tag watched. The full name of a Double tag. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

limits.description: One to four limits, each kind at most once.

block.interlock.description: The conditions that stop a running thing: any abnormal condition latches Tripped and sends the trip writes once, until Reset.

id.description: Unique across the plant's components and controllers. No dot and no whitespace: it prefixes every tag the block owns, as in INT01.Ok.

scanPeriodMs.description: How often the block scans, in milliseconds: a whole number of time steps, at most a day.

claims.description: Tags only this block may write, by full name: each a read-write tag the block commands. A client, a scenario or another block that writes one is refused.

conditions.description: The Bool tags whose abnormal value trips the interlock, in report order.

trip.description: What to command when the interlock trips, once, on the trip scan.

reset.description: What to command when a reset is accepted, once, on the reset scan.

block.permissive.description: The conditions something needs before it may start: Ok while every condition is normal, never latched.

id.description: Unique across the plant's components and controllers. No dot and no whitespace: it prefixes every tag the block owns, as in INT01.Ok.

scanPeriodMs.description: How often the block scans, in milliseconds: a whole number of time steps, at most a day.

claims.description: Tags only this block may write, by full name: each a read-write tag the block commands. A client, a scenario or another block that writes one is refused.

conditions.description: The Bool tags that must be normal, in report order.

block.sequencer.description: A linear sequence of steps, each with entry writes, a transition and an optional timeout, run by Start, Hold, Resume, Abort and Reset.

id.description: Unique across the plant's components and controllers. No dot and no whitespace: it prefixes every tag the block owns, as in INT01.Ok.

scanPeriodMs.description: How often the block scans, in milliseconds: a whole number of time steps, at most a day.

claims.description: Tags only this block may write, by full name: each a read-write tag the block commands. A client, a scenario or another block that writes one is refused.

steps.description: The steps, in order. There is no branching and no parallel step.

abort.description: What to command on an Abort or a step timeout.

block.timer.description: An IEC 61131-3 timer over one Bool tag: on-delay (TON), off-delay (TOF) or pulse (TP).

id.description: Unique across the plant's components and controllers. No dot and no whitespace: it prefixes every tag the block owns, as in INT01.Ok.

scanPeriodMs.description: How often the block scans, in milliseconds: a whole number of time steps, at most a day.

claims.description: Tags only this block may write, by full name: each a read-write tag the block commands. A client, a scenario or another block that writes one is refused.

mode.description: on-delay raises Q once the input has held true for the preset; off-delay holds Q for the preset after the input falls; pulse gives one preset-long pulse on a rising edge.

input.description: The Bool tag timed. The full name of a Bool tag. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

presetS.description: The delay or pulse length. Zero acts immediately. Unit: s.

component.belt-friction.description: Rolling resistance of a loaded belt: force from carried mass, belt mass and added drag.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

emptyBeltMassKg.description: Mass of the moving belt and idlers with no load. Unit: kg.

component.belt-scale.description: Weighs the material passing one point of a belt and reports a mass flow from the load there and the belt speed.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

belt.description: The belt weighed: a belt, or a conveyor that has one. The id of a component that supplies IMaterialObservable. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

positionM.description: Distance of the weigh frame from the tail. Unit: m.

component.bulk-belt.description: A spatially discretised belt for bulk material: what is loaded travels, and stops where it is when the belt stops.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

lengthM.description: Belt length; must be a whole number of cells. Unit: m.

cellSizeM.description: Length of one cell. The belt may not advance more than one cell per tick (DSE006). Unit: m.

maxSpeedMps.description: The fastest the belt will ever be driven. Unit: m/s.

maxLinearDensityKgPerM.description: The most the belt can carry per metre. Unit: kg/m.

transforms.description: Applied, in order, every tick to everything the belt carries.

component.bulk-process-unit.description: A batch unit for bulk material: fills to a recipe, holds until a condition is met while applying transforms, then discharges.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

recipe.description: What one batch is made of.

output.description: What the batch becomes. The name of a bulk material. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

yield.description: Fraction of the batch mass that comes out.

transforms.description: Applied, in order, every tick while holding.

component.bulk-sink.description: Accepts bulk material and destroys it, up to an optional capacity.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

capacityKg.description: How much it will take. Omit for unlimited. Unit: kg.

component.bulk-source.description: Creates bulk material at a commanded rate, from an optional finite hopper.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

material.description: What it feeds; new material takes this material's defined properties. The name of a bulk material. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

rateKgPerS.description: Feed rate when nothing drives the Rate input. Unit: kg/s.

hopperCapacityKg.description: Hopper size. Omit for unlimited. Unit: kg.

enabled.description: Whether the feeder runs before anything writes Enabled. A PLC output is off at power-up; set false to match.

component.conveyor.description: A complete belt conveyor: motor, gearbox, drive and tail pulleys, belt friction, belt, speed sensor, belt scale, current sensor, zero-speed switch, e-stop, pull-keys, safety relay and starter, wired and ready. Faults are injected on the leaves inside it, addressed as <id>.Motor, <id>.Drive, <id>.Scale and so on.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

lengthM.description: Belt length; must be a whole number of cells. Unit: m.

cellSizeM.description: Length of one belt cell. The belt may not advance more than one cell per tick (DSE006). Unit: m.

beltWidthM.description: Belt width; with the angle of repose and density it sets how much a metre of belt can carry. Unit: m.

angleOfReposeDeg.description: Surcharge angle of the material on the belt. Unit: °.

materialDensityKgM3.description: Bulk density used to size the belt's capacity. Unit: kg/m³.

emptyBeltMassKg.description: Mass of the moving belt and idlers with no load. Unit: kg.

tailDragN.description: Tail pulley bearing drag. Unit: N.

pullKeys.description: Number of pull-wire switches along the belt. Unit: count.

speedMarginFraction.description: How far the belt's declared maximum speed exceeds the no-load speed.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

component.discrete-belt.description: A belt carrying individual items at tracked positions, with an optional minimum spacing.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

maxSpeedMps.description: The fastest the belt will ever be driven. Unit: m/s.

minSpacingM.description: Closest two items may sit; must not exceed the length. Unit: m.

transforms.description: Applied, in order, every tick to everything the belt carries.

component.drive-pulley.description: Turns shaft speed into belt speed and belt force into a torque demand.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

bearingDragN.description: Constant drag from the bearings. Unit: N.

component.e-stop.description: An emergency-stop button in a safety loop: not OK while it is held actuated. The button itself does not latch; the safety relay it feeds does.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

component.former.description: Turns bulk material into discrete pieces of a fixed mass, one per cycle. The only place material changes kind.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

input.description: The bulk material consumed. The name of a bulk material. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

output.description: The discrete material produced. The name of a discrete material. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

pieceMassKg.description: Mass of one piece. Unit: kg.

cycleSeconds.description: Time to form one piece. Unit: s.

hopperCapacityKg.description: Bulk material the former can hold. Unit: kg.

outputQueueCapacity.description: Pieces that may wait at the outlet. Omit for unlimited. Unit: count.

component.gearbox.description: A fixed-ratio reducer: divides speed, multiplies torque demand back towards the motor, loses a fixed efficiency.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

component.item-process-unit.description: A batch unit for discrete items — a furnace, a press: takes a batch, holds it while applying transforms, discharges, optionally as a new material.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

output.description: What each item becomes. Omit to keep the material. The name of a discrete material. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

yield.description: Fraction of each item's mass that comes out.

transforms.description: Applied, in order, every tick while holding.

heatWhileHeld.description: Apply the transforms on every tick the unit holds items — filling, processing and discharging — not only while processing, so a batch that cannot leave keeps heating.

component.item-sink.description: Accepts discrete items and destroys them, up to an optional capacity.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

capacity.description: How many items it will take. Omit for unlimited. Unit: count.

component.item-source.description: Mints one discrete item at a fixed interval and queues it at the outlet.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

material.description: What each item is; new items take this material's defined properties. The name of a discrete material. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

itemMassKg.description: Mass of one item. Unit: kg.

queueCapacity.description: Items that may wait at the outlet. Omit for unlimited. Unit: count.

component.motor.description: An induction motor: first-order speed response, current from torque, an I²t thermal state and a breakdown stall.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

component.motor-starter.description: A direct-on-line starter with a thermal overload relay: closes on command when safe, trips on thermal state, resets on a rising edge.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

tripLevel.description: Thermal state at which the overload relay trips.

resetLevel.description: Thermal state below which a reset is accepted. Must be below tripLevel.

component.part-counter.description: Counts items entering a window on a belt and reports whether one is in it now.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

belt.description: The belt watched: a discrete belt, or a composite that has one. The id of a component that supplies IMaterialObservable. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

positionM.description: Centre of the window, from the tail. Unit: m.

windowM.description: Length of the window. Unit: m.

component.pull-key.description: A pull-wire switch along a conveyor, in a safety loop.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

component.pyrometer.description: Reads the temperature of whatever is in its window; reads the background when nothing is.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

target.description: What it looks at: a belt, a conveyor, a chute or a process unit. The id of a component that supplies IMaterialObservable. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

positionM.description: Centre of the window, from the tail. Ignored when the target has no length (a chute or a process unit), which reports its whole contents. Unit: m.

windowM.description: Length of the window. Ignored when the target has no length. Unit: m.

component.safety-relay.description: Energises only while every channel is healthy; once dropped, stays dropped until a reset edge.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.
Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

component.tail-pulley.description: The idle pulley at the tail: contributes bearing drag.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

bearingDragN.description: Constant drag from the bearings. Unit: N.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

component.transfer-chute.description: A small buffer between two belts; backs material up when it is full or blocked.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

capacityKg.description: Mass the chute can hold. Unit: kg.

component.unit-delay-bool.description: Holds a boolean for one tick. Put one on a connection to break an algebraic loop.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

initialValue.description: The output on the first tick.

component.unit-delay-double.description: Holds a number for one tick. Put one on a connection to break an algebraic loop.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

initialValue.description: The output on the first tick.

component.zero-speed-switch.description: Asserts Stopped when the measured speed has stayed below a threshold for a delay.

id.description: Unique in the plant. No dot and no whitespace: a dot separates a component from its port in an address.

thresholdSpeed.description: Speed below which the watched machine counts as stopped, in the spec's unit.

delaySeconds.description: How long the speed must stay below the threshold. Unit: s.

envelope.link.description: A connection from one port to another.

envelope.material.description: A material the plant's components can name.

name.description: What components call it. Unique across the plant and the catalogue.

kind.description: Whether it flows as bulk mass or as discrete items.

states.description: Names of the per-material state values a transform can accumulate into.

properties.description: The properties a source gives new material.

envelope.tag.description: A tag bound to a port, in addition to the tags components declare.

name.description: The tag name a client reads or writes.

access.description: Whether a client may write it. Only an input can be written.

rangeLow.description: Bottom of the range. Give both ends or neither.

rangeHigh.description: Top of the range. Give both ends or neither.

description.description: A sentence fragment; becomes the tag's description.

kind.description: Which limit. Configured limits must ascend lo-lo < lo < hi < hi-hi, each at most once.

value.description: The limit, in the tag's engineering unit.

deadband.description: How far back inside the limit the value must come before the alarm clears.

onDelayS.description: How long the value must stay across before the alarm raises. Unit: s.

tag.description: The tag commanded. The full name of a tag the block commands, so it must be read-write. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

value.description: The value commanded. Converted to the kind of the tag named by 'tag'. The schema cannot check that it fits; the loader does.

tag.description: The Bool tag watched. The full name of a Bool tag. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

normal.description: The value that means the condition is satisfied.

unit.description: Engineering unit of the reading; becomes the tag's unit.

rangeLow.description: Bottom of the calibrated range. The reading clamps here.

rangeHigh.description: Top of the calibrated range; must exceed rangeLow.

noiseSigma.description: Standard deviation of Gaussian noise per tick, in the reading's unit.

lagSeconds.description: First-order response time constant. Unit: s.

ratedSpeedRadPerS.description: Shaft speed at rated load. Unit: rad/s.

ratedCurrentA.description: Current at rated load. Unit: A.

noLoadCurrentFraction.description: Current at zero torque, as a fraction of rated.

lockedRotorCurrentMultiple.description: Starting current, as a multiple of rated.

breakdownTorqueMultiple.description: Torque above which the motor stalls, as a multiple of rated.

accelerationTimeConstantS.description: First-order approach to target speed when energised. Unit: s.

coastTimeConstantS.description: First-order decay to rest when de-energised. Unit: s.

thermalTimeConstantS.description: Time constant of the I²t thermal state. Unit: s.

speedDroopFraction.description: Speed lost at rated torque, as a fraction of rated speed.

inlet.description: Name of the inlet this ingredient arrives at; the unit gets one inlet per line.

material.description: The ingredient. The name of a bulk material. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

massKg.description: Mass of it per batch. Unit: kg.

name.description: A short phrase for the step's event message, without a full stop.

writes.description: What to command on the scan that enters the step.

transition.description: What ends the step: when a tag compares as asked, or after a delay.

timeoutS.description: How long the step may run before the sequence faults and sends the abort writes. Omit for no limit. Unit: s.

object.hold.all.description: Holds until every listed condition is satisfied.

conditions.description: The conditions, all of which must hold.

object.hold.for-seconds.description: Holds the batch for a fixed time.

seconds.description: How long to hold. Unit: s.

object.hold.state-at-least.description: Holds until one of the material's states reaches a value.

material.description: The material whose state is watched. The name of a material. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

state.description: The state watched. The name of a state of the material named by 'material'. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

object.hold.temperature-at-least.description: Holds until the batch is at least this hot.

object.hold.temperature-at-most.description: Holds until the batch has cooled to this.

celsius.description: The temperature to fall to. Unit: °C.

object.transform.moisture-loss.description: Dries the material while it is hotter than a threshold, in proportion to the excess.

ratePerDegreeSecond.description: Moisture fraction lost per degree above the threshold, per second. Unit: 1/(°C·s).

thresholdTemperature.description: Temperature above which drying happens. Unit: °C.

object.transform.residence-accumulator.description: Accumulates, in one of the material's states, the seconds spent at or above a threshold temperature.

material.description: The material whose state is accumulated. The name of a material. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

state.description: The state that accumulates. The name of a state of the material named by 'material'. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

thresholdTemperature.description: Temperature at or above which time counts. Unit: °C.

object.transform.thermal-transfer.description: Moves the material's temperature towards ambient with a first-order time constant.

timeConstantSeconds.description: Time to close 63% of the gap to ambient. Zero snaps to ambient. Unit: s.

object.transition.after.description: Ends the step when its clock reaches a delay.

delayS.description: How long the step runs. Unit: s.

object.transition.when.description: Ends the step when a tag compares with a value as asked.

tag.description: The tag compared. The full name of a tag. The schema cannot check that it exists; the loader does.

op.description: How the tag is compared. A Bool tag allows only == and !=.

value.description: What the tag is compared with. Converted to the kind of the tag named by 'tag'. The schema cannot check that it fits; the loader does.
